newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,735 tonnes of zinc.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Stockpile sells 1,735 tonnes of zinc.

text.p: The Defense National Stockpile Center said it sold 3,824,920 lbs of zinc (1,735 tonnes) for $2,374,620.

The largest buyer was Trademet, taking 1,584,000 lbs, with Colwell Kennedy taking 792,000 lbs. Other buyers were I Shumann and Co, US Zinc, Allied Deals, Parks-Pioneer, Kataman Metals, Allied Fence Mfg, and MAC Group.
Prices ranged from 62.97 to 61.55 cents a lb.
The next offer of zinc by the Stockpile will be on July 15.
